Do not log in and do not click Follow, Like, Reply or any button that changes anything.
Close any login popup if one appears.
Scroll down the profile slowly, about 8 times, to load older posts.
Then store everything you saw as one text, as {{posts}}: for each post by @scribo.voca, write one block that starts with a line ### then the post link (the href of the post time link, like /@scribo.voca/post/XXXX), then a line with the post date or the relative time shown, then the full text of the post exactly as written in Korean.
Include every post you saw, newest first.

summary:
The agent assumed that Escape or clicking outside the login popup would close it. The popup stayed on screen, and the run had not finished the required slow scrolling or collected the post links, dates, and exact text.

verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent did not cause the Threads popup to appear, but it caused the terminal outcome by relying on dismissal actions that did not change the screen and then exhausting its action options instead of treating the logged-out popup state as a blocked collection path. It also completed only the initial scroll activity rather than the requested roughly eight scrolls and never assembled the required {{posts}} output.
